## Summarize the effects across cities

```{r}
tree_dir <- "~/lab-data/datasets/vegetation/StreetTrees/cleaned_ps_input/"
rds_files <- list.files(tree_dir, pattern = "\\.rds$", full.names = TRUE)
cities <- gsub("\\.rds$", "", basename(rds_files))
phe_types <- c("SOS", "EOS")

coef_summary_all <- data.frame()

for (city in cities) {
  r_output_dir <- paste0("~/phenology-urban/data/proc/model_output/final_models_clean_outlier/inla_start/spatial_spde/", city, "/canonicalname/")
  for (phe_type in phe_types) {
    file_path <- file.path(r_output_dir, paste0(phe_type, "_summary.rds"))
    if (file.exists(file_path)) {
      coef_summary <- readr::read_rds(file_path) |>
        dplyr::mutate(phe_type = phe_type, city = city)
      coef_summary_all <- dplyr::bind_rows(coef_summary_all, coef_summary)
    }
  }
}
# For MCMC
# coef_summary_all <- coef_summary_all |>
#   mutate(Estimate = median_value)

plot_coef_cities <- function(coef_summary_all, phe_type){
  coef_summary_all <- coef_summary_all |>
    filter(phe_type == !!phe_type)
  p_coef <-  ggplot() +
    geom_histogram(data = coef_summary_all, 
                   aes(x = Estimate, y = after_stat(count), fill = Estimate > 0), 
                   binwidth = 1, color = NA, boundary = 0, alpha = 0.3) +
    geom_histogram(data = coef_summary_all |> filter(Sig == "*"), 
                   aes(x = Estimate, y = after_stat(count), fill = Estimate > 0), 
                   binwidth = 1, color = NA, boundary = 0, alpha = 1) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("FALSE" = "#FCA636FF", 
                                 "TRUE"  = "#0D0887FF")) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, NA)) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
          axis.line.y = element_line(color = "grey85", linewidth = 0.3),
          axis.ticks.y = element_line(color = "grey85", linewidth = 0.3)) +
    guides(fill = "none") +
    ggtitle(bquote(beta[Temp]~"for"~.(phe_type)))
  return(p_coef)
}

plots_coef_cities <- list()
for (phe_type in phe_types) {
  plots_coef_cities[[phe_type]] <- plot_coef_cities(coef_summary_all, phe_type)
}

wrap_plots(plots_coef_cities, ncol = 2)

summary_per_city <- coef_summary_all |>

    n_sig_neg = sum(Sig == "*" & Estimate < 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_sig_pos = sum(Sig == "*" & Estimate > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_insig_neg = sum(Sig == "" & Estimate < 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_insig_pos = sum(Sig == "" & Estimate > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
```

## Hierarchical model for species slopes within cities

We consider species indexed by $s$ and cities indexed by $c$.\
Each first–stage estimate $\hat{\beta}_{1,s,c}$ has a known sampling variance $v_{s,c}$.

### Level 1: Observation model

$$
\hat{\beta}_{1,s,c} = \beta_{1,s,c} + \epsilon_{s,c},
$$ 

where the sampling error satisfies 

$$
\epsilon_{s,c} \text{ has distribution } \mathcal{N}(0,\, v_{s,c}).
$$

### Level 2: Species effects within each city

$$
\beta_{1,s,c} = \mu_c + \eta_{s,c},
$$ 

where the deviation term satisfies 

$$
\eta_{s,c} \text{ has distribution } \mathcal{N}(0,\, \tau_c^2).
$$

### Implied marginal model for the observed estimates

Combining the two levels gives 

$$
\hat{\beta}_{1,s,c} 
 = \mu_c + (\eta_{s,c} + \epsilon_{s,c}),
$$ 

and because $\eta_{s,c}$ and $\epsilon_{s,c}$ are independent normal errors, we have 

$$
\eta_{s,c} + \epsilon_{s,c} 
\text{ has distribution } \mathcal{N}(0,\, \tau_c^2 + v_{s,c}).
$$

Thus the marginal form is

$$
\hat{\beta}_{1,s,c}
 = \mu_c + \zeta_{s,c},
$$

where

$$
\zeta_{s,c} \text{ has distribution } \mathcal{N}(0,\, \tau_c^2 + v_{s,c}).
$$

-   $\mu_c$: city–level mean response (average slope across species).\
-   $\tau_c^2$: between–species variance within city $c$.\
-   $v_{s,c}$: known sampling variance of $\hat{\beta}_{1,s,c}$.

#### Group by city, shown on map

```{r}
### Group by city and phe_type
library(metafor)

meta_results <- coef_summary_all %>%
  group_by(phe_type, city) %>%
  group_modify(~{
    tryCatch({
      res <- rma(yi = .x$Estimate, sei = .x$sd, method="REML")
      tibble(
        k = res$k,
        mu = res$b[1],
        mu_se = res$se,
        CI_L = res$ci.lb,
        CI_U = res$ci.ub,
        tau2 = res$tau2,
        I2 = res$I2
      )
    }, error = function(e){
      tibble(
        k = nrow(.x),
        mu = NA, mu_se = NA, CI_L = NA, CI_U = NA,
        tau2 = NA, I2 = NA
      )
    })
  })

meta_results_loc <- inventory_centroids |>
  left_join(meta_results, by = c("site" ="city")) |>
  mutate(lon = st_coordinates(x)[, 1],
         lat = st_coordinates(x)[, 2])|>
  filter(!is.na(mu))

plot_df <- meta_results_loc

range_vals <- range(plot_df$mu, na.rm = TRUE)
tau_vals <- unique(plot_df$tau2)
tau_breaks <- pretty(range(sqrt(tau_vals)), n = 5)

p = ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = boundary_us , fill = "grey95", color = "grey85") +
  geom_point(data = plot_df,
             aes(x = lon, y = lat, text = site,
                 size   = (sqrt(tau2) )),
             shape  = 21,
             stroke = 1, # acts as the thickness of the boundary line
             colour = "grey20" # acts as the color of the boundary line
             ) +
  geom_point(
    data = plot_df,
    aes(x = lon, y = lat,  text = site, color = mu, size = sqrt(tau2)), alpha =0.7
  ) +
  scale_color_gradientn(
    name = expression(hat(mu[c])~"(mean estimated effect)"),
    colors = c("#FCA636FF", "white", "#0D0887FF"),
    values = scales::rescale(c(ceiling(range_vals[1] * 10) / 10, 0, floor(range_vals[2] * 10) / 10)),
    breaks = c(ceiling(range_vals[1] * 10) / 10, 0, floor(range_vals[2] * 10) / 10)
  )+
  facet_wrap(~ phe_type) +
  scale_size_continuous(
    name = expression(hat(tau[c]^2)~"(among-species variance)"),
    breaks = (tau_breaks),
    labels = (tau_breaks)^2,
    range = c(3, 12)
  ) +
  guides(
    color = guide_colorbar(order = 1),
    size  = guide_legend(order = 2)
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 20),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 22, face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14)
  ) +
  coord_sf(expand = FALSE)

plotly::ggplotly(p)
```

```{r}
city = "NewYork"
agg_city <- meta_results |> filter(city == "NewYork")

r_output_dir <- paste0("~/phenology-urban/data/proc/model_output/final_models_clean_outlier/inla/spatial_spde/", city, "/canonicalname/")
coef_summary <- map_dfr(
      phe_types,
      ~ read_rds(paste0(r_output_dir, .x, "_summary.rds")) %>%
          mutate(phe_type = .x)
    )

coef_summary$Factor2 <- factor(coef_summary$Factor,
                             levels = unique(coef_summary$Factor))
coef_summary$phe_type <- factor(coef_summary$phe_type,
                              levels = c("SOS", "EOS"))
coef_summary_addcity <- coef_summary |>
  bind_rows(agg_city |> rename(Estimate = mu, Lower = CI_L, Upper = CI_U) |>
          mutate(Factor2 = "zzz_Meta-analysis",
                 SigAlpha = 1) |>
         select(Factor2, Estimate, Lower, Upper, phe_type, SigAlpha))

p_coef <-  ggplot(coef_summary_addcity, aes(x = Factor2, 
                             y = Estimate)) +
  geom_point(aes(alpha = SigAlpha), position = position_dodge(w = 0.5), size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Lower, ymax = Upper, alpha = SigAlpha), 
                position = position_dodge(w = 0.5), 
                width = 0.2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2) +
  labs(x = "Species", y = bquote(beta[Temp]~" estimate")) + 
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 75, hjust = 1, size = 8),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 14)) +
  # coord_flip() +
  facet_wrap(~ phe_type, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_alpha_identity() +
  # geom_text(aes(label = Sig, y = Upper + 0.05  ), hjust = -0.5, show.legend = FALSE) +
  # geom_text(aes(label = Estimate, y = Estimate  ), vjust = -0.7, show.legend = FALSE, size = 3) +
  guides(alpha = "none")

ggsave(
  filename = paste0("~/Desktop/Chp2_city_agg.png"),
  plot = p_coef,
  width = 12,
  height = 6.5,
  dpi = 300
)
```

Tree

```{r}
library(V.PhyloMaker2)
library(ggtree)
library(ggpubr)
library(taxize)
library(ggtreeExtra)

# SP
sp <- gsub("_", " ", sort(unique(coef_summary_all$Factor)))
sp_df_family <- tax_name(sp, get = "family", db = "ncbi")
families <- sp_df_family %>%
  separate(query, into = c("genus", "species_ep"), sep = " ",remove=F) %>%
  rename(species = query) %>%
  dplyr::select(species,genus,family) |>
  filter(!is.na(family)) |>
  rbind(tibble::tribble(
  ~species,                 ~genus,        ~family,
    "Handroanthus impetiginosus", "Handroanthus", "Bignoniaceae",
    "Magnolia loebneri",          "Magnolia",     "Magnoliaceae",
    "Mariosousa heterophylla",    "Mariosousa",   "Fabaceae",
    "Populus acuminata",          "Populus",      "Salicaceae",
    "Populus hybrida",            "Populus",      "Salicaceae",
    "Prunus glandulifolia",       "Prunus",       "Rosaceae",
    "Prunus incam",               "Prunus",       "Rosaceae",
    "Quercus undulata",           "Quercus",      "Fagaceae",
    "Sambucus caerulea",          "Sambucus",     "Adoxaceae",
    "Tilia euchlora",             "Tilia",        "Malvaceae"
))


tr <- phylo.maker(families)
phylo_tree <- tr[[1]]
phylo_tree$tip.label <- phylo_tree$tip.label %>% gsub("_", " ", .)


D <- meta_results_phy %>%
  rename(species = Factor)|>
  mutate(species = gsub("_", " ", species)) |>
  filter(species %in% phylo_tree$tip.label)

sp_data <- sort(unique(na.omit(D$species)))
sp_tree <- sort(phylo_tree$tip.label)
keep_sp <- intersect(sp_data, sp_tree)

# 
D2 <- D %>%
  filter(species %in% keep_sp,
         phe_type == "EOS") %>%
  droplevels() %>%
  mutate(
    species = factor(species, levels = keep_sp),  # ensure order matches A subsetting below
    city = factor(city)
  )
tr2 <- drop.tip(phylo_tree, setdiff(phylo_tree$tip.label, keep_sp))
A2 <- ape::vcv(tr2, corr = TRUE)

D2 <- D2 %>%
  filter(species %in% rownames(A2)) %>%
  mutate(species = factor(species)) %>%
  droplevels()
A2 <- A2[levels(D2$species), levels(D2$species)]

###### Fixed
all_tree <- ggtree(tr2, layout = "circular")+
  geom_tiplab(offset = 55, size =2)
all_ring <- D2 %>%
  transmute(label = species, mu)

p_ring <- all_tree +
  geom_fruit(
    data  = all_ring,
    geom  = geom_col,                               
    mapping = aes(y = label, x = mu, fill = mu),
    orientation = "y",
    width  = 0.6,       
    offset = 0.13,     
    pwidth = 0.25,     
    axis.params = list(axis="none", text=FALSE, line=FALSE, ticks=FALSE)
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#FCA636FF", mid = "white", high = "#0D0887FF", midpoint = 0,
                       name = "Estimate") +
  theme_void()

p_ring
```


Get genus tree

```{r}
genus <- sapply(strsplit(sp, " "), `[`, 1) |> unique() |> vec()
genus_chunks <- split(genus, ceiling(seq_along(genus) / 1))
get_family_chunk <- function(chunk) {
  Sys.sleep(1)  
  tax_name(chunk, get = "family", db = "ncbi", division_filter = "eudicots")
}
genus_df_family_list <- purrr::map(genus_chunks, get_family_chunk)
genus_df_family <- bind_rows(genus_df_family_list)
families <- genus_df_family %>%
  rename(genus = query) %>%
  dplyr::select(genus,family) |>
  filter(!is.na(family)) |>
  rbind(tibble::tribble(
  ~genus,        ~family,
  "Dracaena", "Asparagaceae",
  "Ginkgo", "Ginkgoaceae"
))

tip_df <- data.frame(sp = phylo_tree$tip.label) |>
  mutate(
    sp_clean = gsub("_", " ", sp),
    genus = sub("^(\\S+).*", "\\1", sp_clean)
  )
keep_sp <- tip_df |>
  group_by(genus) |>
  slice(1) |>
  pull(sp)
tree_genus <- drop.tip(phylo_tree, setdiff(phylo_tree$tip.label, keep_sp))
tip_df_keep <- tip_df[match(tree_genus$tip.label, tip_df$sp), ]
tree_genus$tip.label <- tip_df_keep$genus

tree_genus <- collapse.singles(tree_genus)
tree_genus <- di2multi(tree_genus) 

D <- meta_results_phy %>%
  rename(genus = Factor)|>
  mutate(genus = gsub("_", " ", genus)) |>
  filter(genus %in% tree_genus$tip.label)
sp_data <- sort(unique(na.omit(D$genus)))
sp_tree <- sort(tree_genus$tip.label)
keep_sp <- intersect(sp_data, sp_tree)
# 
D2 <- D %>%
  filter(genus %in% keep_sp) %>%
  droplevels() %>%
  mutate(
    genus = factor(genus, levels = keep_sp),  # ensure order matches A subsetting below
    city = factor(city)
  )

# mu for estimation, tau for variance

all_tree <- ggtree(tree_genus, layout = "circular")+
  geom_tiplab(offset = 55, size =2)
all_ring <- D2 %>%
  transmute(label = genus, I2)

p_ring <- all_tree +
  geom_fruit(
    data  = all_ring,
    geom  = geom_col,                               
    mapping = aes(y = label, x = I2, fill = I2),
    orientation = "y",
    width  = 1,       
    offset = 0.13,     
    pwidth = 0.25,     
    axis.params = list(axis="none", text=FALSE, line=FALSE, ticks=FALSE)
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ phe_type) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#FCA636FF", mid = "white", high = "#0D0887FF", midpoint = 0,
                       name = "Estimate") +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
  strip.text = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"))

p_ring
```

### Marginal Climate

```{r}
# most_sp <- table(coef_summary_all$Parameter,coef_summary_all$phe_type) |> as.data.frame()
# Gleditsia triacanthos
# Acer platanoides
# Acer saccharum
# Celtis occidentalis
# Cercis canadensis
# Fraxinus americana
# Fraxinus pennsylvanica
# Ginkgo biloba
# Liquidambar styraciflua
# Liriodendron tulipifera
# Platanus hispanica
# Quercus bicolor
# Quercus palustris
# Robinia pseudoacacia
# Tilia cordata
# Ulmus parvifolia
# Ulmus pumila
# "Ulmus pumila"

library(ggpubr)

plot_marginal <- function(species_name, coef_summary_all, clim = "mean_temp", phe_type = "EOS") {
  if(clim %in% c("mean_prcp", "mean_temp")) {
    new_city_feature <-  read_rds(paste0("~/phenology-urban/data/proc/model_output/nooutlier_", phe_type, "_input.rds")) |>
    filter(year < 2024) |>
    mutate(year = as.factor(year))|>
    filter(canonicalname == species_name) |>
    group_by(city) |>
    summarise(
      across(starts_with("temp"), ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE), .names = "mean_temp"),
      across(starts_with("prcp"), ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE), .names = "mean_prcp"))
  } else if (clim %in% c("bio1", "bio12")) {
    new_city_feature <- readRDS(here("~/phenology-urban/data/raw/CONUS/StreetTrees/cleaned_ps_input/summary/city_feature.rds")) |>
      select(site, all_of(clim)) |>
      rename(city = site)
  } else {
    stop("clim variable not recognized")
  }
  
  
  combine_feature <- coef_summary_all |>
    filter(Factor == species_name) |>
    mutate(w = 1/(sd^2)) |>
    left_join(
      new_city_feature,
      by = "city"
    )

  df_eos <- combine_feature |>
    filter(phe_type == !!phe_type)

  if (nrow(df_eos) < 2) return(NULL)

  # lm
  fmla <- as.formula(paste0("Estimate ~ ", clim))
  fit_w <- lm(fmla, data = df_eos, weights = w)

  summary_fit <- summary(fit_w)
  R2   <- summary_fit$r.squared
  pval <- summary_fit$coefficients[2, 4]
  label_text <- sprintf("italic(R)^2 == %.2f *','~~italic(p) == %.3f", R2, pval)

  # interval
  newdat <- data.frame(
    clim_var = seq(min(df_eos[[clim]], na.rm = TRUE),
                   max(df_eos[[clim]], na.rm = TRUE),
                   length.out = 200)
  )
  names(newdat) <- clim

  pred <- predict(fit_w, newdata = newdat, se.fit = TRUE)
  newdat$y_pred <- pred$fit
  newdat$y_lwr  <- pred$fit - 1.96 * pred$se.fit
  newdat$y_upr  <- pred$fit + 1.96 * pred$se.fit

  # plot
  p <- ggplot(df_eos, aes(x = .data[[clim]], y = Estimate, alpha = SigAlpha)) +
    geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = Lower, ymax = Upper, colour = Color)) +
    geom_ribbon(data = newdat,
                aes(x = .data[[clim]], ymin = y_lwr, ymax = y_upr),
                inherit.aes = FALSE,
                fill = "grey80", alpha = 0.4) +
    geom_line(data = newdat,
              aes(x = .data[[clim]], y = y_pred),
              inherit.aes = FALSE,
              colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.8) +
    annotate("text", x = Inf, y = Inf,
             label = label_text, parse = TRUE,
             hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.5, size = 6) +
    scale_alpha_identity() +
    scale_colour_identity() +
    guides(alpha = "none") +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(
      title = species_name,
      x = case_when(
        (rlang::as_name(clim) %in% c("mean_prcp", "bio12")) ~ "Mean Annual Precipitation (mm)",
        (rlang::as_name(clim) %in% c("mean_temp", "bio1")) ~ "Mean Annual Temperature (°C)"
      ),
      y = paste0("Estimated effect on ", phe_type)
    ) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 22),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 16),
      axis.title = element_blank(),
      title = element_text(face = "italic")
    )

  return(p)
}



species_vec <- c(
  "Acer saccharinum",
  "Acer rubrum",
  "Pyrus calleryana",
  "Quercus rubra",
  "Gleditsia triacanthos",
  "Ulmus americana"
)
library(cowplot)
plot_list <- lapply(species_vec, plot_marginal,coef_summary_all, clim = "bio12", phe_type = "EOS")
names(plot_list) <- species_vec
p_marg <- cowplot::plot_grid(plotlist = plot_list, ncol = 2) + 
  theme(plot.margin = margin(b = 30, l = 30, r = 20),
        panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
        plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA))
p_marg_xy <- ggdraw() +
  draw_plot(p_marg) +
  draw_label("Mean annual precipitation (mm)",
             x = 0.5, y = 0.03, size = 22) +
  draw_label(bquote("Estimated mean "~beta[Temp]~" estimate"),
             x = 0.02, y = 0.5, angle = 90, size = 22)

ggsave("~/phenology-urban/temp/figure_agu/marginal_effects2.png", p_marg_xy, width = 9, height = 10, dpi = 500)
```

### Phylogeny

Prepare tree

```{r}

library(V.PhyloMaker2)
library(ggtree)
library(ggpubr)
library(taxize)
sp <- gsub("_", " ", sort(unique(coef_summary_all$Factor)))
sp_df_family <- tax_name(sp, get = "family", db = "ncbi")
families <- sp_df_family %>%
  separate(query, into = c("genus", "species_ep"), sep = " ",remove=F) %>%
  rename(species = query) %>%
  dplyr::select(species,genus,family) |>
  filter(!is.na(family)) |>
  rbind(tibble::tribble(
  ~species,                 ~genus,        ~family,
    "Handroanthus impetiginosus", "Handroanthus", "Bignoniaceae",
    "Magnolia loebneri",          "Magnolia",     "Magnoliaceae",
    "Mariosousa heterophylla",    "Mariosousa",   "Fabaceae",
    "Populus acuminata",          "Populus",      "Salicaceae",
    "Populus hybrida",            "Populus",      "Salicaceae",
    "Prunus glandulifolia",       "Prunus",       "Rosaceae",
    "Prunus incam",               "Prunus",       "Rosaceae",
    "Quercus undulata",           "Quercus",      "Fagaceae",
    "Sambucus caerulea",          "Sambucus",     "Adoxaceae",
    "Tilia euchlora",             "Tilia",        "Malvaceae"
))
tr <- phylo.maker(families)
phylo_tree <- tr[[1]]
phylo_tree$tip.label <- phylo_tree$tip.label %>% gsub("_", " ", .)

# Test SOS

# new_city_feature <-  read_rds(paste0("~/phenology-urban/data/proc/model_output/nooutlier_EOS_input.rds")) |>
#     filter(year < 2024) |>

new_city_feature <- readRDS(here("~/phenology-urban/data/raw/CONUS/StreetTrees/cleaned_ps_input/summary/city_feature.rds")) |>
  select(site, bio1, bio12) |>
  rename(city = site)

D <- coef_summary_all %>%
  rename(species = Factor)|>
  mutate(species = gsub("_", " ", species)) |>
  filter(phe_type == "EOS", species %in% phylo_tree$tip.label) |>
  left_join(new_city_feature, 
    by = c("city"))

sp_data <- sort(unique(na.omit(D$species)))

sp_tree <- sort(phylo_tree$tip.label)
keep_sp <- intersect(sp_data, sp_tree)

D2 <- D %>%
  filter(species %in% keep_sp) %>%
  droplevels() %>%
  mutate(
    species = factor(species, levels = keep_sp),  # ensure order matches A subsetting below
    city = factor(city)
  )
tr2 <- drop.tip(phylo_tree, setdiff(phylo_tree$tip.label, keep_sp))
A2 <- ape::vcv(tr2, corr = TRUE)

D2 <- D2 %>%
  filter(species %in% rownames(A2)) %>%
  mutate(species = factor(species),
         bio12_s = as.numeric(scale(bio12, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)),
         bio1_s = as.numeric(scale(bio1, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)),
         w = 1 / (sd^2)) %>%
  droplevels()
A2 <- A2[levels(D2$species), levels(D2$species)]
```

pglmm

```{r}
library(phytools)
library(phyr)

m_city <- pglmm(
  Estimate ~ 1+ (1|species__) + bio1_s + bio12_s,
  data = D2,
  family = "gaussian",
  cov_ranef = list(species = A2),
  bayes = TRUE
)

plot_bayes(m_city, sort = TRUE)
```

The residual

```{r}
library(lme4)
library(phytools)
m_city_nophyr <- lmer(Estimate ~ bio12_s+ bio1_s + (1|city),
                      data = D2, weights = w)
D2$resid <- residuals(m_city_nophyr)
resid_species <- aggregate(resid ~ species, data = D2, mean)

common_species <- intersect(tr2$tip.label, resid_species$species)
phy <- drop.tip(tr2, setdiff(tr2$tip.label, common_species))
resid_species <- resid_species[match(common_species, resid_species$species), ]
resid_vec <- resid_species$resid
names(resid_vec) <- resid_species$species

phylosig(tr2, resid_vec, method = "K", test = TRUE)
phylosig(phy, resid_vec, method = "lambda", test = TRUE)
```

The variance components

```{r}
library(lme4)
m_city_nophyr <- lmer(Estimate ~ (1|species) + bio12_s+ bio1_s + (1|city),
                      data = D2, weights = w)

###### Random
re_df <- ranef(m_city_nophyr, condVar = TRUE)$species

blup <- as.numeric(re_df[, 1])
sp_df <- tibble(
  species = rownames(re_df),
  blup = blup
)
postVar <- attr(ranef(m_city_nophyr, condVar = TRUE)$species, "postVar")
se_blup <- sqrt(sapply(1:dim(postVar)[3], function(i) postVar[1, 1, i]))
sp_df$blup_se <- se_blup

all_tree <- ggtree(tr2, layout = "circular")+
  geom_tiplab(offset = 55, size =2)
all_ring <- sp_df %>%
  transmute(label = species, blup)

###### Fixed
all_tree <- ggtree(tr2, layout = "circular")+
  geom_tiplab(offset = 55, size =2)
all_ring <- as.data.frame(summary(m_city_nophyr)$coefficients) |>
  rownames_to_column("label") |>
  mutate(label = str_remove(label, "^species")) |>
  filter(label != "(Intercept)")

p_ring <- all_tree +
  geom_fruit(
    data  = all_ring,
    geom  = geom_col,

  ) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#FCA636FF", mid = "white", high = "#0D0887FF", midpoint = 0,
                       name = "Estimate") +
```

```{r}
m <- lmer(Estimate ~  (1|Factor) + (1|city), data = coef_summary_all %>%
            filter(phe_type == "SOS"), weights = 1/(sd^2))
summary(m)
VarCorr(m)


var_city <- coef_summary_all %>%
  group_by(phe_type, city) %>%
  summarise(var_city = var(Estimate, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# 2) variance of the same species across cities (within phe_type)
var_species <- coef_summary_all %>%
  group_by(phe_type, Factor) %>%
  summarise(var_species = var(Estimate, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# 3) For each Factor-city pair, attach these two variances
out <- coef_summary_all %>%
  select(phe_type, Factor, city) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  left_join(var_city, by = c("phe_type", "city")) %>%
  left_join(var_species, by = c("phe_type", "Factor"))

line_data <- data.frame(
  x = range(out$var_city, na.rm = TRUE)
) |>
  dplyr::mutate(y = x)  # 1:1 line

ggplot(out, aes(x = var_city, y = var_species)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.3, alpha = 0.6) +
  
  geom_line(data = line_data, aes(x = x, y = y, color = "1:1 line"),
            linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.8) +

  facet_wrap(~ phe_type, scales = "free") +

  scale_color_manual(
    name = "",
    values = c("1:1 line" = "red", "Fitted regression" = "blue")
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
  x = expression(paste("Var(", beta[temp], ") within one city, across species")),
  y = expression(paste("Var(", beta[temp], ") within one species, across cities"))
)
```

```{r}
library(randomcoloR)

unique_cities <- c("CapeCoral", "TP", "StAugustine", "Sacramento", 
                   "SanJose", "Berkeley", "Anaheim", "Austin", "LosAngeles")

  left_join(coef_summary_all |> 
    group_by(Factor) |> 
    summarise(
      n_city = n_distinct(city),
      .groups = "drop"
    ),

  filter(city %in% unique_cities)

p <- ggplot(
```
